_readme: The stage card for a long (multi-stage) skill, run by system/parts/stage_runner.py (see RUNNER.md beside this file). Copy into your skill folder as card.json and fill in. One stage = one step of the skill. mode 'talk' means the person converses and moves on with /next; mode 'alone' means the step runs unattended and advances on a verified pass. Placeholder stages below show the shape -- replace them. Every path is relative: 'prompt' to this card's folder, 'out'/'extra'/'inputs' to the run folder the runner creates. checks vocabulary: headings (lines that must appear exactly), min_words (prose words under headings), code_word (a line 'Code word: <word>' matching the word the runner handed out), forbid (forbidden_content.py rules -- the runner calls that part, never re-implements it), require_sections (section_present.py rules), order (order_lint.py rules), phase_gate ({phase, contract} for phase_gate.py). Keep every check backed by one of the parts -- do not invent a check the runner does not know.

forbid.why: spec: named only in a later stage

order.why: spec: the arc first, then the verdict
